lines.text: By bus, not with the bus!
Many learners say: I go to work with the bus.
Better: I go to work by bus.
By! I go to work by bus.

data.wrong: I go to work with the bus.
data.right: I go to work by bus.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagen wir „mit dem Bus“. Im Englischen sagen Sie „by bus“, ohne „the“.
native.caption: Sagen Sie „with the bus“? 🚌 Falsch: “I go to work with the bus.” Richtig: “I go to work by bus.” Hören Sie Carlos zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: German says “mit dem Bus.” English says “by bus,” with no “the.”
en.caption: “Mit dem Bus” is “by bus”! Wrong: “I go to work with the bus.” Right: “I go to work by bus.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
